profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer @ Celonis AI
profile.summary:
https://anthonyabsher.replit.app/

Finding ways that tech can be a positive force for change on our planet and our communities. When all we have is this planet, I believe its important to do what we can to preserve it.

Check out a bit of my work at https://github.com/anthonyabsher

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Applied ML & AI Apps Team
 • Owned end-to-end product delivery across multiple AI-enabled applications, participating in user feedback cycles, shaping requirements, and building intuitive interfaces backed by scalable services and APIs.
• Architected the integration of large-scale, event-driven  AI-centric image processing pipelines, enabling the ingestion and feature extraction of unstructured data in files into structured, usable business datasets in a scalable manner.
• Researched, designed, tested, and delivered an AI-centered anomaly detection model trained on customer process data, including a specialized version running inference on sets of 1M+ customer invoices.
• Designed and delivered an application that reduced our customers’ setup and implementation time for a custom AI deduplication algorithm from multiple days to less than one minute. 
• Collaborated cross-functionally with product managers and engineering teams across global timezones to deliver project requirements effectively and quickly iterate on collected feedback for our apps.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Business Knowledge Team
 - Led the development of a frontend component used throughout the platform that provides a simple & feature-rich interface for users to explore their business data through Celonis' Process Query Language.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Data, Solutions, and Analytics Team  |  Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
 • Led the design and development of foundational data tools used by business decision-makers to optimize the construction and maintenance of cell towers, enabling the allocation of over $1 billion of materials for this purpose.
• Engineered distributed microservices using AWS/Azure (S3, Lambda, Databricks, Kubernetes) to process large-scale datasets, ensuring high availability and resilience for mission-critical business logic.
• Implemented DevOps best practices—including automated CI/CD pipelines and comprehensive monitoring (AppDynamics)—to ensure 99.9% application uptime, incident resolutions,  and streamlined production deployments.
• Managed and mentored team members, fostering professional development, facilitating cross-team collaboration, and overseeing project development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Data, Solutions, and Analytics Team | Full Stack Software Engineer
 - Creating APIs to manage controlled access into a robust database of internal information.
 - Developing full stack applications from start to finish using an agile methodology. This process includes planning requirements with stakeholders across teams, designing architecture to best fit needs, and then the implementation of the applications.
- Overseing DevOps for our team's applications. Creating back-end, front-end, and database monitors and collecting application statistics using the monitors.
- Creating a smart chatbot service using Microsoft Bot Framework. This provides social integration between our apps and users.
- Utilizing AWS and Azure cloud services such as S3, Lambda, Databricks, and Azure Data Factory to develop microservices to support our applications.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Device Quality Assurance Dept. | Associate Automation Testing Engineer
 - Defined testing goals and expectations for device validation
 - Created automated test suites and analyzed test results
 - Aggregated test results for reporting key performance metrics
 - Ran test scripts on tens of devices through parallel test script automation
 - Tested T-Mobile internal apps for app health  KPIs

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Device Quality Assurance Dept. | Automation Testing Intern
 - Managed the health and stability of hundreds of devices in a lab
 - Tested health KPIs for T-Mobile internal applications using automated test scripts
 - Aggregated test results for reporting purposes

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a team to create a digital store front for the Jubile REACH thrift store
 - Designed and implemented the database for the store's backend
- Oversaw the development of server logic to connect the store's backend data to the client side

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
- Reinforced fundamental concepts of computer science for students by guiding them through problems regarding syntax, data structures, and algorithms.
 - Facilitated study groups for students preparing for exams

positions.title: Media Technician
